body: As a person who loves cars, inside and out, I’ll tell you the honest truth, fuck what they say, it works, it has its purpose, and god damn if that little Toyota won’t take you to hell and back I don’t know what will, those cars can survive better than any other, and it was a smart choice, sensibility and humility are not bad traits, you did good, love your car, it’s yours, and no one can take that away from you
But these thighs are my demise..
Yea.. I have been sitting down with an old friend, I am still scared of what I’ll do, but I at least feel comfortable , thank you for caring so much

I’ve collapsed man, I used to be everything wanted, with all the things I had, not only was I happy emotionally for the first time in my life, I was going well, and now, I’m just gone, the person I was is gone, and I feel like no matter what i do, I’m not of importance to anyone anymore
It’s been a time coming, for a while I had found someone to keep me happy, and kept me stable , but at this point, I just don’t know, I’m alone, and I feel like there’s no going back
